nodes.label: Pterodactyl Node.js Egg
nodes.rationale: Egg runs npm install at start (downloads Next.js and ffmpeg); MAIN_FILE index.js; fallback startup 'npm install && node index.js'.

nodes.label: AAC Stream (?format=aac)
nodes.rationale: Bandwidth-saving secondary stream chosen on mobile or via quality toggle.

nodes.label: Fallback Jingle (public/jingle.mp3)
nodes.rationale: Played instead of silence when nothing is queued.

nodes.label: Icecast
nodes.rationale: config/icecast.xml generated from config/icecast.example.xml and .env.local passwords; not committed; refuses to start with weak passwords.

nodes.label: Listener Requests
nodes.rationale: Requests with sender and message (max 200 chars, no links, profanity masked); moderator approves or rejects; expire after 30 min; rate-limited per IP.

nodes.label: Live Microphone (WebSocket /mic)
nodes.rationale: Voice sent via WebSocket to broadcaster and mixed into stream with automatic music ducking (-8/-14/-20 dB/full) returning after ~1s silence.

nodes.label: Public Deployment
nodes.rationale: VPS/Railway/Fly.io, persistent disk for downloads/, HTTPS required for browser autoplay.

nodes.label: Spotify Import (POST /api/import)
nodes.rationale: Import track or playlist (max 50 songs); yt-dlp downloads, ffmpeg saves track.mp3 into downloads/{uuid}/.

nodes.label: TRUST_PROXY / Reverse Proxy
nodes.rationale: Only trust X-Forwarded-For behind own reverse proxy (nginx/Caddy).

nodes.label: Miss Radio Pterodactyl Deployment
nodes.rationale: Package for Pterodactyl generic Node.js egg (Node 20+); web, radio and studio mic run on a single port.

nodes.label: AI Radio
nodes.rationale: Own internet radio: Spotify -> downloaded MP3 -> live HTTP stream with crossfade.

nodes.label: HTTPS Required for Microphone
nodes.rationale: Browsers allow mic only on HTTPS or localhost; put domain with HTTPS (Cloudflare/reverse proxy) in front and set TRUST_PROXY=1.

nodes.label: Broadcaster
nodes.rationale: Always running; per-track decoder, PCM mixer (crossfade, jingle, skip with fade) and a single persistent MP3 encoder so there are no gaps between tracks.

nodes.label: Burst Buffer for New Listeners
nodes.rationale: New listener gets a few seconds of buffer so playback starts immediately.

nodes.label: Crossfade Transition
nodes.rationale: Configurable via RADIO_CROSSFADE_SEC, RADIO_CROSSFADE_CURVE (equalpower recommended), RADIO_TRANSITION.

nodes.label: Rotation Algorithm
nodes.rationale: No repeat until ~60% of library played, same artist spaced by 3 others, remainder weighted lottery favoring long-unplayed tracks.

nodes.label: Studio Security
nodes.rationale: STUDIO_PASSWORD min 12 chars (studio locked in production otherwise), 7-day sessions, logout invalidates token, login rate limits, Origin check, CSP and security headers.

nodes.label: Smart Mix (LUFS analysis)
nodes.rationale: Each track measured once for LUFS loudness, start and ending shape; normalized to station target and transitions adapted (fading endings blend earlier, hard endings play out, quiet intros come in under previous ending).

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Warning
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version differs from training data; read node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing code and heed deprecations. Block is re-added by next dev.
